gloss: to persist; to stick with it; to persevere

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {粘|ねば}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to persist; to stick with it; to persevere
definitions.explanation: To continue stubbornly or tenaciously despite difficulties, often implying staying in a situation longer than expected.

definitions.gloss: to be sticky; to be viscous
definitions.explanation: Physical property of being adhesive or having a thick, sticky consistency.

notes:
{粘|ねば}る has both abstract (persistence) and physical (stickiness) meanings.

SENSE 1 - PERSISTENCE:
- ⟦{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い→粘り強い：07165_nebarizuyoi⟧: tenacious, persistent
- {粘|ねば}り{勝|が}ち: winning through persistence
- {粘|ねば}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粘|ねば}る: to persist stubbornly

SENSE 2 - STICKINESS:
- ⟦{粘|ねば}り{気|け}→粘り気：16218_nebarike⟧: stickiness, viscosity
- {粘|ねば}{粘|ねば}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be slimy/sticky (onomatopoeia)
